title: mixcore core API v0.1: MeterScale()
description: The meter display scale and ballistics every UI uses (design CR-17, open question 24). Family-independent; the protocols send raw levels only.

minDB.description: Bottom of the drawn scale; lower levels and -inf draw as empty.

maxDB.description: Top of the drawn scale (0 dBFS).

clipDB.description: A level at or above this lights the clip block.

nominalDB.description: Nominal operating level, drawn as a mark.

releaseDBPerSecond.description: How fast a shown level falls (MeterRelease).

peakHoldMs.description: How long a peak indicator holds before it falls.
